description: This file defines the PdfStructureElement class, representing the root of a structure tree element in PDF documents, including methods for managing structure hierarchy, attributes, and serialization preparations.

classes.name: PdfStructureElement
classes.description: Represents a structure element within a PDF’s structure tree, handling hierarchy, attributes, and serialization logic.

methods.name: PdfStructureElement
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new structure element, setting its type key.

methods.name: PdfStructureElement
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new structure element associated with a specific PdfDocument.

methods.name: PrepareForSave
methods.description: Prepares the structure element and its children for being saved into a PDF document, simplifying children array and attributes.

methods.name: GetKids
methods.description: Retrieves all child PdfDictionary objects from the '/K' key, supporting nested arrays.

methods.name: GetPdfDictionary
methods.description: Resolves and returns a PdfDictionary from a PdfItem or PdfReference, or null if not applicable.

methods.name: SimplifyKidsArray
methods.description: If the '/K' key contains a single-element array, simplifies it to that element.

methods.name: SimplifyAttributes
methods.description: Removes empty or unnecessary attribute dictionaries or arrays from the '/A' key.

methods.name: AttributeDictionaryIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether a PdfDictionary has no meaningful entries, considering the presence of only a required '/O' key as empty.

methods.name: LayoutAttributes
methods.description: Gets or creates a PdfLayoutAttributes instance stored in '/A'.

methods.name: TableAttributes
methods.description: Gets or creates a PdfTableAttributes instance stored in '/A'.

methods.name: GetAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an attribute object of type T within the '/A' array, ensuring only one instance exists.
